messages.dispatch.outcome.queued: Action {action} on agent {agent} is queued and has not been claimed.
messages.dispatch.outcome.claimed: {admission, select, yes {Action {action} on agent {agent} was admitted for {effects, list} and has not reported an outcome.} other {Action {action} on agent {agent} is claimed and has not reported an outcome.}}
messages.dispatch.outcome.succeeded: Action {action} on agent {agent} was reported as succeeded by {reporter} at {at, time}.
messages.dispatch.outcome.failed: Action {action} on agent {agent} was reported as failed by {reporter} at {at, time}.
messages.dispatch.outcome.canceled: {admission, select, yes {Admission of action {action} on agent {agent} was refused at {at, time}; nothing was permitted.} other {Action {action} on agent {agent} was canceled at {at, time}.}}
messages.dispatch.outcome.unrecognized: Action {action} on agent {agent} is in a state this renderer does not recognize: {state}.
messages.dispatch.error.request_not_sent: The failure was reported as request_not_sent, which, if accurate, means no byte of the request reached a connection.
messages.dispatch.error.request_not_sent.next: Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again: the report says nothing was sent, but the record cannot establish that.
messages.dispatch.error.outcome_unknown: The failure was reported as outcome_unknown, which, if accurate, means the request may have been written and nothing establishes whether the effect happened.
messages.dispatch.error.outcome_unknown.next: Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again.
messages.dispatch.error.retry_exhausted: The failure was reported as retry_exhausted, which, if accurate, means every permitted attempt was retryable and at least one may have been written.
messages.dispatch.error.retry_exhausted.next: Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again.
messages.dispatch.error.input_invalid: The failure was reported as input_invalid, which, if accurate, means the input could not be bound to its route and nothing was sent.
messages.dispatch.error.input_invalid.next: Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again, and correct the input: the report says nothing was sent, but the record cannot establish that.
messages.dispatch.error.target_rejected: The failure was reported as target_rejected_{status}, which, if accurate, means the target gave a final refusal with HTTP status {status}.
messages.dispatch.error.target_rejected.next: Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again, and review the refusal at the target.
messages.dispatch.error.invalid_executor_output: The failure was reported as invalid_executor_output, which, if accurate, means the executor’s output did not match the action’s output schema.
messages.dispatch.error.invalid_executor_output.n: Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again, then fix the executor.
messages.dispatch.error.invalid_executor_evidence: The failure was reported as invalid_executor_evidence, which, if accurate, means the executor’s evidence was malformed or outside its time bounds.
Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again, then fix the executor.
messages.dispatch.error.invalid_executor_error: The failure was reported as invalid_executor_error, which, if accurate, means the executor’s own error code was refused as malformed.
messages.dispatch.error.invalid_executor_error.ne: Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again, then fix the executor’s error reporting.
messages.dispatch.error.executor_error: The failure was reported as executor_error, which, if accurate, means the executor failed without giving an error code.
messages.dispatch.error.executor_error.next: Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again.
messages.dispatch.error.unrecognized: The failure was reported with an error code Shoal does not define: {code}.
messages.dispatch.error.unrecognized.next: Reconcile with the target before requesting the work again; Shoal cannot interpret the code.
messages.dispatch.reason.canceled_after_lapse: It was canceled after its last claim lapsed without a report.
messages.dispatch.evidence: The executor returned {n, plural, one {# evidence reference} other {# evidence references}} from snapshot {snapshot} as of {asof, time}.
messages.dispatch.gap.effect_possible: The action declares an external or egress effect and is claimed, so an effect may already have happened.
messages.dispatch.gap.no_evidence: The result carries no evidence references.
messages.dispatch.history.requested: {admission, select, yes {{requester} requested admission at {created, time}, with a deadline of {deadline, time}.} other {{requester} enqueued it at {created, time}, with a deadline of {deadline, time}.}}
messages.dispatch.history.approved: {approver} approved the request at {approved, time}, under policy generation {policy}.
messages.dispatch.history.claims: {claims, plural, =1 {It was claimed once.} other {It was claimed # times; the {lapsed, plural, one {first lease} other {first # leases}} lapsed without a report.}}
messages.dispatch.history.claimant: {live, select, yes {The claim is held by {claimant}, with a lease of {lease, duration} ending {until, time}.} no {The last claim, held by {claimant}, ended at {until, time} without a report.} ended {The last claim was held by {claimant}.} other {The last claim was taken by {claimant}, with a lease of {lease, duration} ending {until, time}.}}
messages.dispatch.blocked.lease_live: It cannot be claimed again or canceled until the lease ends at {until, time}, {left, duration} from now.
messages.dispatch.blocked.lease_lapsed: The lease ended at {until, time}, so {admission, select, yes {the caller} other {the claimant}} can no longer report on it.
messages.dispatch.blocked.deadline_passed: The deadline passed at {deadline, time}, so it can no longer be claimed.
messages.dispatch.blocked.unclaimed: No worker has claimed it yet.
messages.dispatch.next.succeeded: Nothing further happens to this action; its output is recorded.
messages.dispatch.next.canceled: {claimed, select, yes {Nothing further happens to this action; because it was claimed before it was canceled, reconcile with the target before requesting the work again.} other {Nothing further happens to this action.}}
messages.dispatch.next.none: Nothing further can happen to this action through dispatch.
messages.dispatch.next.options: What can happen next: {options, list, or}.
messages.dispatch.next.edge.claim: a worker claims it before the deadline at {deadline, time}
messages.dispatch.next.edge.complete: {admission, select, yes {the caller} other {the claimant}} reports success before the lease ends at {until, time}
messages.dispatch.next.edge.fail: {admission, select, yes {the caller} other {the claimant}} reports failure before the lease ends at {until, time}
messages.dispatch.next.edge.reclaim: once the lease ends at {until, time}, another worker claims it before the deadline at {deadline, time}
messages.dispatch.next.edge.cancel_lapsed: once the lease ends at {until, time}, it is canceled
messages.dispatch.transition.enqueue: At {at, time}, {requester} enqueued it with a deadline of {deadline, time}.
messages.dispatch.transition.admit: At {at, time}, {requester} was admitted for {effects, list}.
messages.dispatch.transition.deny: At {at, time}, admission for {requester} was refused.
messages.dispatch.transition.claim: At {at, time}, {claimant} claimed it with a lease of {lease, duration}.
messages.dispatch.transition.reclaim: At {at, time}, after the previous lease lapsed, {claimant} claimed it again with a lease of {lease, duration}.
messages.dispatch.transition.cancel: At {at, time}, it was canceled before anyone claimed it.
messages.dispatch.transition.cancel_lapsed: At {at, time}, it was canceled after its last claim lapsed.
messages.dispatch.transition.claim_run: Between {first, time} and {last, time} it was claimed {count, plural, other {# times}}{named, plural, =0 {} other { by {claimants, list}}}; each claim before the last lapsed without a report.
messages.dispatch.transition.unrecognized: At {at, time}, it took a transition this renderer does not recognize: {kind}.
messages.approval.outcome.pending: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} is pending approval until {expires, time}.
messages.approval.outcome.approved: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} is approved and has not yet become work.
messages.approval.outcome.refused: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} was refused.
messages.approval.outcome.expired: {verdict, select, approve {The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} was approved but expired at {expires, time} before it became work.} other {The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} expired at {expires, time} without a decision.}}
messages.approval.outcome.expired.window_closed: {stored, select, approved {The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} was approved but has expired: its window closed at {expires, time} before it became work.} other {The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} has expired: its window closed at {expires, time} without a decision.}}
messages.approval.outcome.enqueued: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} was approved and became work at {materialized, time}.
messages.approval.outcome.enqueued.enqueued_witho: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} was approved and committed to become work at {materialized, time}, but the action has not been written.
messages.approval.outcome.unresolvable.identity_t: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} was approved but can never become work.
messages.approval.outcome.unresolvable.target_mov: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} can no longer progress.
messages.approval.outcome.unresolvable.policy_gen: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} can no longer progress.
messages.approval.outcome.unresolvable.deadline_p: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} can no longer progress.
messages.approval.outcome.unrecognized: The request to run action {action} on agent {agent} is in a state this renderer does not recognize: {state}, with condition {condition}.
messages.approval.reason.window_closed: Expiry is written lazily, by the next request or decision, so the stored record has not caught up.
messages.approval.reason.enqueued_without_action: The write that creates the action was lost after the approval was committed.
messages.approval.reason.identity_taken: Another route’s action already holds this action identity.
messages.approval.reason.target_moved: Agent {agent} has moved past generation {generation}, or is gone, since the request was made.
messages.approval.reason.policy_generation_moved: The policy generation in force has moved since the request was made under generation {policy}.
messages.approval.reason.deadline_passed: The action deadline passed at {deadline, time}, so the request can no longer be re-requested.
messages.approval.reason.stored_differs: The stored record still says {stored, select, pending {pending} approved {approved} enqueued {enqueued} refused {refused} expired {expired} other {something else}}; this status is computed and nothing was written.
messages.approval.transition.requested: {requester} requested it at {requested, time} under policy generation {policy}, with an action deadline of {deadline, time}.
messages.approval.transition.expired_undecided: Its window closed at {expires, time} before anyone decided it.
messages.approval.transition.expired_unused: Its window closed at {expires, time}, after it was approved and before it became work.
messages.approval.transition.materialized: It was committed to become work at {materialized, time}.
messages.approval.blocked.pending: It is waiting for an eligible approver{timed, select, yes {; the window closes {left, duration} from now} other {}}.
messages.approval.blocked.approved: It is waiting for the requester to re-request it{timed, select, yes {; the window closes {left, duration} from now} other {}}.
messages.approval.blocked.enqueued_without_action: It is waiting for the requester to re-request it so that the action is written.
messages.approval.next.window_closed: Nothing further can happen to this request; a new request needs its own approval.
messages.approval.next.enqueued_without_action: The requester can re-request the same request before {deadline, time} to write the action, while agent {agent} stays at generation {generation} and the policy generation holds.
messages.approval.next.identity_taken: Make a new request under a different action identity; it needs its own approval.
messages.approval.next.target_moved: Make a new request against the agent’s current generation; it needs its own approval.
messages.approval.next.policy_generation_moved: Make a new request under the policy generation now in force; it needs its own approval.
messages.approval.next.deadline_passed: Make a new request with a later deadline; it needs its own approval.
messages.approval.next.enqueued: Where the work is now is the action’s own status.
messages.approval.next.final: Nothing further can happen to this request; a new request needs its own approval.
messages.approval.next.options: What can happen next: {options, list, or}.
messages.approval.next.edge.approved: an eligible approver approves it before {expires, time}
messages.approval.next.edge.refused: an eligible approver refuses it before {expires, time}
messages.approval.next.edge.expired_undecided: no one decides it and it expires at {expires, time}
messages.approval.next.edge.expired_unused: the requester does not come back and it expires at {expires, time}
messages.approval.next.edge.materialized: the requester re-requests the same request before {expires, time} and it becomes work
messages.decision.outcome.completed: Decision task {task} {version} completed at {at, time} with {answered, plural, =0 {no answers} one {# answer} other {# answers}} and {abstained, plural, =0 {no abstentions} one {# abstention} other {# abstentions}} across {subjects, plural, one {# subject} other {# subjects}}.
messages.decision.outcome.abstained: Decision task {task} {version} abstained on the whole request at {at, time}; no answers were recorded.
messages.decision.outcome.failed: Decision task {task} {version} failed at {at, time}; no answers were recorded.
messages.decision.reason.abstained.evidence_ineli: The abstention was reported, by the predictor or the service, as evidence_ineligible, which, if accurate, means the evidence for at least one requested subject did not meet the task’s evidence policy.
messages.decision.reason.abstained.unrecognized: The abstention was reported, by the predictor or the service, with a reason Shoal does not define: {reason}.
messages.decision.reason.failed.predictor_unavail: The failure was reported, by the predictor or the service, as predictor_unavailable, which, if accurate, means the registered predictor could not be resolved for this release.
messages.decision.reason.failed.predictor_identit: The failure was reported, by the predictor or the service, as predictor_identity_mismatch, which, if accurate, means the resolved predictor did not match the identity the request pinned.
messages.decision.reason.failed.deadline_exceeded: The failure was reported, by the predictor or the service, as deadline_exceeded, which, if accurate, means no result arrived within the deadline.
messages.decision.reason.failed.predictor_failed: The failure was reported, by the predictor or the service, as predictor_failed, which, if accurate, means the predictor returned an error.
messages.decision.reason.failed.invalid_predictor: The failure was reported, by the predictor or the service, as invalid_predictor_response, which, if accurate, means the predictor’s response did not satisfy the result contract.
messages.decision.reason.failed.unrecognized: The failure was reported, by the predictor or the service, with a reason Shoal does not define: {reason}.
messages.decision.next.completed: {abstained, plural, =0 {Use these answers only to order inspection; they do not authorize excluding anything.} other {Inspect the abstained subjects ordinarily; use the answers only to order inspection, never to exclude anything.}}
messages.decision.next.abstained.evidence_ineligi: If the evidence was ineligible, fix the gaps or request only eligible subjects in a new decision request; until then, inspect ordinarily.
messages.decision.next.abstained.unrecognized: Inspect the subjects ordinarily; an abstention is not a finding.
messages.decision.next.failed.predictor_unavailab: If the predictor was unavailable, request the decision again once the release is available; until then, inspect ordinarily.
messages.decision.next.failed.predictor_identity_: If the identity did not match, check the predictor registration against the release before requesting again; until then, inspect ordinarily.
messages.decision.next.failed.deadline_exceeded: If the deadline passed, request the decision again with a later deadline; until then, inspect ordinarily.
messages.decision.next.failed.predictor_failed: If the predictor failed, request the decision again or investigate it; until then, inspect ordinarily.
messages.decision.next.failed.invalid_predictor_r: If the response was invalid, investigate the predictor’s output before requesting again; until then, inspect ordinarily.
messages.decision.next.failed.unrecognized: Inspect ordinarily; a failure is not a finding.
messages.decision.answer.choice: For subject {subject}, question {question}, the predictor chose {label}{reported, select, yes {, with a reported probability of {p, number}} other {}}.
messages.decision.answer.ordinal: For subject {subject}, question {question}, the predictor chose level {label}, {rank} of {levels}{reported, select, yes {, with a reported probability of {p, number}} other {}}.
messages.decision.answer.probability: For subject {subject}, question {question}, the predictor reported a probability of {p, number}.
messages.decision.answer.abstained.unavailable: For subject {subject}, question {question}, the predictor reported that no answer was available.
messages.decision.answer.abstained.unrecognized: For subject {subject}, question {question}, the predictor abstained, giving its own reason: {reason}.
messages.decision.answers.more: {n, plural, one {# more answer is} other {# more answers are}} not shown.
messages.decision.gap.truncated: The evidence was truncated to fit the token budget ({tokens, number} input tokens against a budget of {budget, number}), so no subject could be scored.
messages.decision.gap.disposition.unsupported: {n, plural, one {# subject contains} other {# subjects contain}} constructs the evidence builder does not support: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.gap.disposition.missing: {n, plural, one {# subject has} other {# subjects have}} no evidence: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.gap.disposition.out_of_scope: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} outside the picture’s scope: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.gap.subject_reason: For subject {subject}, the evidence builder recorded: {reason}.
messages.decision.gap.more_reasons: {n, plural, one {# more recorded reason is} other {# more recorded reasons are}} not shown.
messages.decision.gap.measurement.unknown: Measurement {measurement} counted {n, number} {unit} against an unknown total, so its coverage is unknown.
messages.decision.gap.measurement.not_applicable: Measurement {measurement} has a known total of zero {unit}: it is not applicable, which is not the same as complete.
messages.decision.gap.inventory: {supported, number} of {total, number} enumerated subjects have supporting evidence, and the enumeration itself does not prove that nothing was missed.
messages.decision.history.requested: {principal} requested it at {requested, time} under release {release}, with a deadline of {deadline, time}.
messages.decision.inspection.evidence_truncated: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because the evidence was truncated: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.source_stale: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because a source observation is older than the evidence policy allows: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.source_role_rejected: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because a source has a role the evidence policy does not allow: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.source_control_rejec: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because a source is controlled in a way the evidence policy does not allow: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.source_authority_rej: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because a source’s authority policy is not one the evidence policy allows: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.source_attestation_m: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because a source lacks the attestation reference the evidence policy requires: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.coverage_unsatisfied: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because a required coverage measurement is missing, unknown or insufficient: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.subject_unsupported: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because the subject has no supported evidence: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.subject_not_evaluate: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because the prediction did not evaluate the subject: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.prediction_failed: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because the prediction failed: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.inspection.prediction_abstained: {n, plural, one {# subject is} other {# subjects are}} held because the predictor abstained: {subjects, list}.
messages.decision.eligibility.outcome: {eligible, number} of {total, number} {total, plural, one {subject} other {subjects}} may be scored under the task’s evidence policy.
messages.decision.eligibility.next: {held, plural, =0 {All subjects may be scored; eligibility checks structure only and does not establish that the evidence is true.} other {Subjects that may not be scored are inspected ordinarily; fix the evidence named above and request a new decision to score them.}}
messages.decision.ranking.outcome: {eligible, number} of {total, number} {total, plural, one {subject was} other {subjects were}} scored; {held, plural, =0 {none is held for ordinary inspection} one {# is held for ordinary inspection and listed first} other {# are held for ordinary inspection and listed first}}.
messages.decision.ranking.next: Priority orders inspection only; no score, threshold or position permits excluding a subject.
messages.interaction.asserted_reason: {by} asserted the reason code {code}{detail, select, source {, naming the source {source}} digest {, with free-form detail retained only as a digest} other {}}; Shoal records this but does not verify it.
